question: Which college was established in Banaras in 1791?
solution:
The correct answer is **Sanskrit ****College. ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• Hindu College:

 
 
• In Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India, there is a collegiate, central, and research university called Hindu College.
 
• In 1916, it was founded.
 
• The Central Hindu College, established in 1898 by Annie Besant, was absorbed into the university.
 
• Madan Mohan Malaviya founded the university when Besant and her friends were sidelined.
 
• Banaras Hindu University is India's first central university.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Dayanand College** :

 
 
• A **publicly sponsored, UGC-recognized** college with ties to** Guru Jambheswar University Hisar** is Dayanand College Hisar.
 
 
 
• **Shivaji College:**
 
 
• A** coeducational institution** with ties to the University of Delhi is Shivaji College.
 
 
 
• ​Sanskrit College, Banaras: ​
 
 
• In 1791, Jonathan Duncan founded the college to promote the study of Hindu laws and philosophy in Banaras.
 
• In 1958, the Sanskrit College became a university. 
 
• In 1974, the name was changed to Sampurnanand Sanskrit Vishwavidyalaya.
